changelog:
- X (Twitter) Loading & Stability Fix: Eliminated GraphQL in-flight fetch decoding conflicts and Relay schema desync, restoring smooth loading on x.com and twitter.com without 'Try again' errors.
- Robust Cosmetic Ad Shield for Social Networks: Replaced destructive DOM removals and payload splicing with zero-latency, crash-proof CSS element hiding and style-level collapse for promoted tweets and trends.
- Protected Social CDN Delivery: Whitelisted core social infrastructure domains (twimg.com, abs.twimg.com, t.co) to ensure asset and Webpack bundles stream without disruption.
- Pure Android System WebView v2.2.0 release (17.4 MB).
